description: YEC Power substations is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Yukon Energy Corporation (YEC) Power S ubstations are the locations where electrical power is transformed, generally from high to low voltage. This data was provided by YEC and will be updated when new substations are constructed. Distributed from GeoYukon by the Government of Yukon. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are electrical, energy, geoyukon, geoyukon-import, geoyukon-import-20250714. It offers 5 resource(s) in ESRI REST, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
